opened.detail: Not required: one shoulder closed (Note 8's Case 11 exception). Signs placed: 0 left, 10 right. MUTCD 11th Ed. DOTI standards and details not read. Source: CDOT S-630-1 (July 2026) Sheet 2, General Note 8
